home.quote: Gradle: identical resolved versions, lockfile tracked. Node: `npm ci` succeeds and leaves the tree clean

reason: Not a real pair: EXEC-02 reads the lockfiles, whether git tracks them and the manifests beside them. An AGENTS.md line about regenerating the lockfile is not read, so it cannot change the verdict.
Not a real pair: EXEC-02 reads the lockfiles and the manifests beside them, never a shell script. Switching a start-up script to npm ci cannot change the verdict.

Not a real pair: EXEC-01 reads the pin files (.nvmrc, .python-version and the others) and the version fields of the manifests. Dockerfiles, compose files and documented prerequisites are not read, so aligning them with the pin cannot change the verdict.
Not a real pair: EXEC-01 reads the pin files and the manifests' version fields, never a CI workflow. A workflow that reads the pin cannot change the verdict.
